articles.title: Quantum Particles Can Spend 'Negative Time' in a Cloud — And It's Real!
articles.summary: Scientists shot light particles through a cloud of atoms and found they exited before they entered — like spending negative time inside. Even the atoms agreed! The experiment proves this weird quantum effect is more than an illusion.

articles.title: August's Full Moon Will Turn Blood Red During a Stunning Eclipse!
articles.summary: On August 28, the full Sturgeon Moon will pass through Earth's shadow, turning a spooky red. Up to 96% of the moon will be covered! Look up late on August 27 to catch the show across the Americas, Europe, and Africa.

articles.title: Baby Birds Get a Weather Forecast While Still Inside the Egg!
articles.summary: Zebra finch parents sing a special 'heat call' to their unhatched chicks. This song changes the babies' brains so they can handle hot weather better after hatching. It's like a built-in weather warning!
